The SMB Foods standard
What earns a place in our catalog.
Every product we import, make or distribute clears the same four tests. It is how we keep a shelf a retailer can trust without reading every label.
Beyond Organic. Beyond The Label.
Certified organic is where we start, not where we stop.
Certified organic means a product meets the USDA National Organic Program or the EU Organic Program: grown, handled and processed without synthetic chemicals, GMOs or artificial additives, with annual inspections to prove it. We respect that standard and sell to it wherever a product is certified.
But certification mostly describes how a crop is grown. So before anything reaches your shelf we also look at how it is processed, what goes into the finished product and how consistent the quality is from lot to lot. Organic is a plus. Clean, honest and thoughtfully made is the standard.
Quality & purity
100% natural ingredients, free from synthetic preservatives and artificial additives. Products we are proud to put our own name beside.
Sustainability
Organic farming that protects soil and biodiversity, and sourcing decisions that consider the planet at every step, from grower to warehouse.
Community impact
We support local farmers, villages and small producers, and we make and pack the Organicopia line in Lebanon.
Reliability
Consistency is key for a business. We built our supply chain so you have access to the same products, at the same quality, whenever you need them.
Sourcing the best
Authentic organic ingredients from growers around the world, each checked against global standards before we list it.
Lab tested where it matters
Our spices, seeds, powders and nut butters carry a Lab tested pill when the lot has been laboratory tested for quality and purity.
Personalised service
One point of contact on WhatsApp for stock, pricing, labelling questions and delivery, whether you run one shop or twenty.
Our story
Your partner in healthy living.
In a market full of processed options, finding reliable, accessible health products shouldn't be a struggle for a business or for the families it serves. Soul Mind Body Foods was created to close that gap.
We started as importers, bringing certified organic ingredients into Lebanon that met the strictest USDA and EU standards and sharing them with shops, cafés and kitchens that wanted to offer healthier alternatives. Along the way we became producers too: today the Organicopia line is sourced, made and packed by our own team in Lebanon.
We are not just another distributor. Our philosophy is simplicity and purity: pure ingredients, conscious decisions, and farming methods that protect the land and the people who work it. A healthier world starts with what goes into the jar, and with the partners who put it on the shelf.
Whether you stock one product or the full range, we see our work as a way to give back: to you, to the communities we source from, and to the planet.
Global sourcing, local production
We source the finest organic ingredients from around the world and proudly produce a growing range in Lebanon, from ghee to fresh baked petit four.
Home of Organicopia
Organicopia is our consumer brand: clean, thoughtfully sourced pantry staples for Lebanese kitchens. Your customers can also shop it directly at organicopia-lb.com.
